name: codex-onboarding-skill
description: Create a low-friction Codex Starter Pack for new agent users.

interface.shortDescription: Install, ask preferences, then initialize the current project.
interface.longDescription: After installation, Codex should ask a short 3-question preference intake before initializing the current project as a Codex Starter Pack. It can generate a draft for an existing project without overwriting current files, and supports GitHub, zip, and local folder install sources.
